verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Companies House has an authenticated REST API with registered API keys and an Authorisation guide. Nothing documents scoped or least-privilege credentials, such as per-key permissions, read-only versus write scopes, or restricting a key to specific resources. Plain API-key authentication is an adjacent auth capability, not the scoped-credential capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
